name: destlist_v4
description: Read the DestList stream of a Windows jump list, version 4 (the 130-byte entry layout): for each entry its place in the stream, entry id, host name, last access (FILETIME and UTC), pin state and target path. The stream, not the compound file around it; another version is refused, not guessed. A cut-short stream is read as far as it goes and says so; entries beyond a page go to a file.

path.description: The DestList stream, as a file (read only)

offset.description: Where the stream starts in the file (default 0)

limit.description: Entries in the answer (default 200); the whole list goes to a file when there are more
